encode_sentence_with_bart: encode a sentence into BPE tokens using the BART hub interface encode method
decode_tokens_with_bart: decode a tensor of BPE tokens back into human-readable text using the BART decode method
generate_text_with_bart: generate text from tokenized input sentences using the BART hub interface generate method
extract_features_with_bart: extract model embeddings from tokenized sentences using the BART extract_features method
fill_mask_with_bart: fill masked tokens in input text using the BART hub interface fill_mask method
